title: Belgium Tightens Its Borders and Its Belt · 19 Aug
keywords: Belgium, migration policy, citizenship, asylum, nationality fee, budget, debt, fiscal consolidation, EU migration standards, interest rates, inflation, public finances, austerity, social cohesion
notes: Belgium is simultaneously hardening its migration and citizenship rules and grappling with a budget squeeze driven by rising debt-service costs, creating a dual pressure on public finances and social cohesion. Nationality applications have reportedly halved after fees rose sharply, while higher interest rates are eating into government room for manoeuvre. Together, the two policy fronts are redefining what the Belgian state offers its residents and who it allows to become one of them.
